title: Neela Hummel on Anthropic: 'the separation of two roles we usually conflate'
summary: Hummel, a certified financial planner who runs a B Corp wealth firm, reads the Anthropic filing for how it splits the upside from the votes. Public shareholders get the economics while a trust with a mission mandate elects most of the board.
blockquote: What excites me most is the separation of two roles we usually conflate: economics and stewardship.
